title: GRASP: Group-Adaptive Hybrid RL-SFT Post-Training for Medical VQA without Reasoning Annotations
abstract: arXiv:2610.34561v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adapting general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) to medical visual question answering (VQA) is valuable for helping clinicians read images and make diagnoses, but annotated data are scarce and provide only short answers, without reasoning annotations. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) fits these labels but overfits to them and amplifies their biases, eroding out-of-domain (OOD) generalization. Reinforcement learning (RL) better preserves generalization but never uses the gold answer as a training target: GRPO-style algorithms learn from the contrast between correct and incorrect answers within a group of sampled responses, so all-correct or all-wrong groups give no correctness signal. Existing SFT-RL hybrids either apply SFT and RL in separate stages or switch between them per question, or need reasoning traces from experts or stronger models, which medical VQA data lack. translated_title: GRASP：面向无推理标注医学视觉问答的群体自适应混合强化学习-监督微调后训练
translated_abstract: 将通用视觉语言模型（VLM）适配到医学视觉问答（VQA）任务中，对于帮助临床医生读片和做出诊断具有重要价值，但标注数据稀缺，且只提供简短答案，没有推理标注。监督微调（SFT）能够拟合这些标签，但会过拟合这些标签并放大其偏差，从而损害分布外（OOD）泛化能力。强化学习（RL）能更好地保持泛化能力，但从不把标准答案作为训练目标：GRPO风格的算法依靠一组采样回答中正确与错误答案之间的对比来学习，因此全对或全错的组无法提供正确性信号。现有的SFT-RL混合方法要么在不同阶段分别应用SFT和RL，要么在每个问题之间切换两者，要么需要专家或更强模型提供的推理轨迹，而这些在医学VQA数据中都是缺失的。我们提出GRASP，它在每次更新中同时结合RL和SFT，利用群体自适应机制……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: GRASP提出一种群体自适应的RL-SFT混合后训练框架，在每次更新中同时融合强化学习与监督微调，使视觉语言模型在缺乏推理标注的医学视觉问答场景下既能保证答案准确性又能保持良好的泛化能力。
